acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-01: `pnpm install` at the repo root installs all three workspaces, and every `package.json` declares `engines.node >=24` and the root declares `pnpm >=11`.

verification.definingInputProperty: A clean lockfile install across the three workspace packages
verification.assertions: Install succeeds with no lockfile drift

verification.command: python3 -c "import json,glob;ps=['package.json']+glob.glob('apps/*/package.json')+glob.glob('packages/*/package.json');assert len(ps)==4;assert all(json.load(open(p))['engines']['node']=='>=24' for p in ps);assert json.load(open('package.json'))['engines']['pnpm']=='>=11';print('engines ok',len(ps))"
verification.definingInputProperty: Every package.json in the workspace, root included
verification.assertions: engines.node is >=24 everywhere and the root declares pnpm >=11

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-02: `pnpm typecheck` passes for every workspace with TypeScript `strict` and `allowImportingTsExtensions` enabled.

verification.definingInputProperty: All workspaces plus tools/ compiled by tsc
The shared base tsconfig every workspace extends

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-03: `pnpm lint` runs Biome with the rules from plexq `templates/typescript/biome.json` (no semicolons, double quotes, 140-column lines, `noExplicitAny`, `noConsole`) and reports zero errors.

verification.definingInputProperty: Every TypeScript, TSX, JSON, and CSS file in the repo
verification.observedResult: Checked 74 files in 54ms. No fixes applied.

verification.command: python3 -c "import json;b=json.load(open('biome.json'));f=b['javascript']['formatter'];r=b['linter']['rules'];assert f['semicolons']=='asNeeded' and f['quoteStyle']=='double' and b['formatter']['lineWidth']==140;assert r['suspicious']['noExplicitAny']=='error' and r['suspicious']['noConsole']=='error';print('biome rules ok')"

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-04: `docker-compose.yml` runs PostgreSQL 18 and creates both the `todo` and `todo_test` databases.

verification.definingInputProperty: The compose file as Docker parses it
verification.assertions: Valid compose definition using image postgres:18 with the init script mounted
verification.observedResult: Valid: image postgres:18, POSTGRES_DB todo, docker/init-test-db.sql mounted at /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d. Separately, docker/init-test-db.sql executed on a fresh PostgreSQL 18.6 cluster produced databases todo and todo_test.

verification.definingInputProperty: A live PostgreSQL server reached through DATABASE_URL
verification.observedResult: 1 passed | 2 skipped (3) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

verification.command: pnpm db:up && docker exec todo-app-postgres psql -U todo -d todo -tAc "select string_agg(datname, ',' order by datname) from pg_database where datname like 'todo%'"
verification.definingInputProperty: The real postgres:18 container started from docker-compose.yml on the developer's Mac
verification.observedResult: Not run: Docker Hub (registry-1.docker.io) is blocked from the build environment, so the container itself has not been started yet. Run this on the Mac, record the result, then set this criterion to satisfied.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-05: `pnpm db:migrate` creates the `todo_item` table with `id uuid default uuidv7()`, `title text not null`, `notes text`, `is_completed`, `is_test_data`, `created_timestamp`, `updated_timestamp`, and `deleted_timestamp`, and running it a second time changes nothing.

verification.definingInputProperty: A brand-new, empty PostgreSQL 18 database created by the test
verification.assertions: First run applies 1_create_todo_item; second run applies nothing; all eight columns, types, nullability, and defaults match; ids are UUIDv7; blank titles rejected
verification.observedResult: 2 passed | 1 skipped (3) (the skipped tests are the ones outside this -t filter, not skipped tests; the full-suite inventory run reports 0 skipped)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-06: `packages/contract` exports the `TodoAppApi` definition, the `TodoItem`, `CreateTodoRequest`, and `UpdateTodoRequest` schemas, and the `TodoNotFound` and `CsrfRejected` errors, and both `apps/api` and `apps/web` import from it.

verification.command: python3 -c "import re,glob;s=open('packages/contract/src/index.ts').read();names=['TodoAppApi','TodoItem','CreateTodoRequest','UpdateTodoRequest','TodoNotFound','CsrfRejected'];assert all(re.search(r'\\b'+n+r'\\b',s) for n in names);users=[f for f in glob.glob('apps/*/src/**/*.ts*',recursive=True) if '@todo/contract' in open(f).read()];assert any(u.startswith('apps/api') for u in users) and any(u.startswith('apps/web') for u in users);print('exports ok; importers',len(users))"
verification.definingInputProperty: The contract barrel file and every source file in apps/api and apps/web
verification.assertions: All six names are exported and both apps import @todo/contract

commands.observedResult: Checked 74 files in 54ms. No fixes applied.
